findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.comment: Observed eggs to be stored above other TCS items in cooler. Discussed with PIC, eggs were moved to bottom of cooler. Ensure proper storage order is maintained to prevent any possible contamination.
findings.citation_text: 3-302.11(A)(2) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (2) Except when combined as ingredients, separating types of raw animal FOODS from each other such as beef, FISH, lamb, pork, and POULTRY during storage, preparation, holding, and display by: (a) Using separate EQUIPMENT for each type, or (b) Arranging each type of FOOD in EQUIPMENT so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented, and (c) Preparing each type of FOOD at different times or in separate areas.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, and used; test strips.
findings.comment: Observed no sanitizer solution to be made upon inspection. Discussed with PIC, sanitizer was set up and tested at 100 ppm CL. Ensure sanitizer solution is made and available during all hours of operation.
findings.citation_text: 4-303.11(A) Cleaning Agents and Sanitizers, Availability. (A) Cleaning agents that are used to clean EQUIPMENT and UTENSILS as specified under Part 4-6, shall be provided and available for use during all hours of operation.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. 

The refrigerator in the kitchen is observed with an air temperature of 51F. Multiple items in the cooler (both TCS and non-TCS) were probed for internal temperatures. Items included cream cheese, syrup, apple sauce and deli meats and were all in the cooler overnight and throughout today per the PIC. Temperatures were measured between 49F and 51F. Milk was the only exception at 42F. PIC stated that milk was moved rom another cooler this morning. The milk was not deemed to be a danger and moved directly back to the other cooler (later observed at 33F. All other TCS foods in the refrigerator (deli meat/sandwiches, cream cheese, butter and cottage cheese) were discarded during the inspection. The refrigerator has been turned down farther and maintenance has been contacted to verify that no issues with the equipment exist. Inspector will spot check next week to verify compliance.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.17: (A) Attachments to walls and ceilings (i.e. light fixtures, fans, decorative items) shall be EASILY CLEANABLE. 
 
1) The caulking in the eastern bathroom around both hand sinks was observed cracking and with a significant gap between the wall and sink. Attachments to walls and ceilings shall be smooth and easily clean able. Instructed PIC to repair. 2) The caulking in the western bathroom is observed cracking and pulling away from the wall. PIC is instructed to repair/ maintain repaired.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.citation_text: 2-201.11 (E) (Pf) No documentation was observable during the inspection for employees being made aware of reportable symptoms and diagnosis related to food borne illness in a food establishment. Reporting agreements were made available to the facility during the inspection and a spot check will take place 1/14/19 to review compliance.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.citation_text: 6-201.17  (C) The caulking in the eastern bathroom around both hand sinks was observed cracking and with a significant gap between the wall and sink. Attachments to walls and ceilings shall be smooth and easily clean able. Instructed PIC to repair.

findings.title: Walls, ceilings, and attached equipment, properly constructed, clean
findings.comment:
750-1210e  Equipment attached to walls and ceilings shall be easily clean able and shall be maintained in good repair.

Observed a sink the front boys bathroom and another in the bathroom in the baby area to be pulling away from the wall. Discussed the relevant issues with the PIC and instructed them to repair/ replace the caulking around the sinks to provide a smooth easily clean able surface.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment:
750-820d Equipment and utensils shall be sanitized in the third compartment according to one of the methods included in section 750.820 (e) (1) through (4).

On arrival, the sink designated for sanitizing (wash/rinse/sanitize) was registering approximately 20 parts per million (ppm) chlorine (cl). Cl sanitizers should register between 50 ppm and 100 ppm in solutions intended for sanitizing food contact surfaces. Discussed with the person in charge and the solution was adjusted during the inspection to the correct concentration.

findings.title: Toxic items labeled and used properly
findings.comment: 750-1300 Containers of poisonous or toxic materials necessary for the maintenance of the establishment shall be labeled in accordance with law. Properly label containers of toxic substances. Observed a container of bleach that's label had fallen off. Chemicals containers should have a label on them. Discussed with PIC and label was added.

findings.title: Cold food at proper temperatures during storage, display, service, transport, and cold holding
findings.comment: 750-120(a) Observed several items stored in the reach in cooler in the kitchen to have internal temperatures of 47F to 48 F including lunch meat, cheese sticks, and milk. Cooler is not holding proper temperature. See violation #4. TCS foods not to be used in the next 1-2 days shall be removed from this unit and stored in the other unit on-site. Food remaining in this cooler shall be stored at an internal temperature of 45 F. Food shall be stored at 41 F or below unless otherwise indicated (e.g. milk and eggs).

findings.title: Facilities to maintain proper temperatures
findings.comment: 750-140 Observed the reach in cooler in the kitchen to have an internal air temperature of approximately 51 F. Cooler appears to be overstocked in a manner that impedes air flow to products. TCS foods such as cheese, lunch meat, and milk were probed during inspection with internal temperatures of 47 F to 48 F. See violation #3a. Cooler was turned down during inspection. Facility may remove food from the unit and monitor and record the internal air temperature and food temperatures. Facility shall record temperatures in a temperature log. Temperatures should be recorded three times a day: at the beginning of the day (prior to breakfast), after lunch prep, and at the end of day (at the end of snack prep). Facility management states that if monitoring demonstrates unit is no longer properly functioning it may be replaced.  Inspector will SPOT CHECK facility on 6/22/17 to determine if cooler is holding the proper temperature (41 F or below).

findings.title: Thermometers provided and conspicuously placed
findings.comment: 750.140a- Observed the thermometer in the refrigerator to be broken.  A thermometer was placed in the refrigerator.
